fields.summary_ko.0: MediaTek is scheduled to release October monthly revenue on November 10, and issued Q4 guidance of NT$210.1–221.8 billion revenue (up 25–32% YoY) following Q3 revenue of NT$168.058 billion (up 18.3% YoY).
